current transaction-hash links to the existing explorer
actual deep-link builder and route parser
read-only visualizer feature and public origin claim

fixture.provenance: Value is declared by pinned Grid3 source as a script CellDep transaction hash. It is not claimed as a transaction broadcast by Grid3 or independently checked on chain.

isolation: Reviewed source acquisition and hash validation happened outside the execution container.
No package installation or external dependencies were required.
Only the generated route-check bundle was mounted read-only.
Container had no network, credentials, signer keys or home directory.
Read-only root filesystem, no capabilities, non-root UID 1000, no-new-privileges, process/memory/CPU/time/output limits.
Generated bundle and transient staging directory were deleted after recording output hashes.

cases.description: positive: Grid3 source constants provide the existing explorer origin and a pinned CKB CellDep transaction-hash fixture; Trycove adapter calls the actual CKB Viz URL builder; actual CKB Viz parser returns the same hash and testnet network
negative: malformed hash rejected by the adapter
negative: unsupported devnet rejected by the adapter
negative: route that changes the validated hash or network rejected by the adapter

license.restriction: No license grant was identified at the inspected revisions. Source code was not committed; the combined bundle existed only in transient private staging for this bounded execution and was destroyed.

limitations: The only runtime consumer module exercised is Grid3 constants.ts; the actual React signer hook and game page were inspected but not executed.
The fixture hash is a Grid3 source-declared CellDep transaction hash, not a Grid3 transaction produced by sendTransaction and not an independently verified on-chain transaction.

This run proves only read-only URL adapter and CKB Viz parser behavior, not provider deployment availability, RPC success, cell-flow correctness, transaction acceptance, chain compatibility, user value, adoption or maintainer approval.
Unlicensed upstream repositories were used only for this transient private compatibility test; no source bundle was retained or redistributed.
reproduction: Acquire the exact repositories and checkout the recorded full commit SHAs.
